Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in comparing the dates. It correctly identified the release dates (Go Ahead And Break My Heart: May 9, 2016; Knee Deep In My Heart: November 29, 2013) but incorrectly concluded that the 2013 song was released more recently. May 2016 is chronologically after November 2013, so "Go Ahead And Break My Heart" is the more recent release.
